statement: V26:77 was too restrictive: radio alone does not create doctrine, but 1937-42 continuous combat + reliable comms does produce procedural/tactical evolution.
GT quiet-radio comparison -> EMI source isolation -> shielding/bonding/filtering/noise-acceptance engineering.
Important-aircraft acceptance requirements and naval/recon/bomber spread make usable radio increasingly normal enough to support procedure.
China shifts bottleneck from hardware-only to reporting/procedure/organization; contact, leader-status, reform/RTB and task-ownership procedures mature.
Leader-centered radio discipline, short standard reports, prebriefed sector/altitude/reform procedures and attack/support/lookout roles develop within three-plane shotai structure.
A6M enters combat into a radio-assisted tactical culture; three-plane shotai retained but split/reform, high-cover and sequential-pass coordination become more robust.
Carrier concentration + warning/plot/readiness procedures produce preplanned division CAP sectors/altitude bands, CAP leaders and group-level ship-to-fighter vector/retask.
First-line A6M normal serviceable state uses COM2 reliable leader-level voice; COM3 local, COM0/1 still possible from fault/congestion/damage.
CMD2 shotai/chutai task allocation normal; CMD3 group-level carrier control achievable pre/early contact, degrading in dense merge; no CMD4 precision GCI.
Formal three-plane shotai/nine-plane chutai retained; no universal two-plane/finger-four conversion.
Type21 feeds an already-developed report/plot/vector procedure; it improves cueing but not precision altitude or individual tracking.
Define Apr29 CarDiv5 CAP command/report/sector/relief state and discipline-failure modes before A14/A16/A18 valid-release replay.
